fetchErrorSessionRejected.message: Kick isn't recognizing your session right now, even though you're logged in. This usually happens when signed in via Google, Apple, or another social account, due to an inconsistency on Kick's own servers — it's not a bug in this extension. Fix: log out of kick.com and log back in with your email and password. If you don't have a password (because you signed up via Google/Apple), use "Forgot password?" on the login screen to set one. If that doesn't help, this usually resolves on its own within a few minutes.

emailLoginNotice.message: For KickAlert to work reliably, we recommend logging into Kick with email and password. Signing in with "Google," "Apple," or another social account can sometimes prevent the extension from loading your data, due to an inconsistency on Kick's own servers.

emailLoginInfo.message: Tip: KickAlert works most reliably when you're logged into Kick with email and password. Social logins like Google or Apple can occasionally cause session inconsistencies on Kick's servers.

thumbnailsWarning.message: Shows a live preview image under each live channel. This sends one extra request per live channel each time the popup opens, which carries a small risk of Kick flagging the activity as bot-like.

whatsNewBannerText.message: New: fixed a critical Cloud Sync bug where your Chat tab settings could silently reset on their own. Check out Settings to explore.

releaseHistoryV0Body.message:
• Fixed the Chat tab's Kick username field silently failing to save if you typed it and closed the popup right away
• Fixed the same root issue elsewhere: favorite channels, per-channel sound mode, channel groups, the auto-open list, the chatroom/channel ID cache, bot scores, and notification history could all lose a change if two updates landed close together — all of these now go through a write queue so this can no longer happen
• Fixed a critical Cloud Sync bug: if Cloud Sync was on, your Chat tab settings could silently revert to an old/empty state hours later with zero interaction, because a routine background sync check kept re-applying a stale cloud copy. Chat settings now sync immediately on every change, and that background check no longer re-pulls from the cloud on its own

releaseHistoryV1Label.message: v2.5 — Ad blocking, chat notifications & settings redesign

releaseHistoryV1Body.message:
• Three new ad-blocking layers: GPT/IMA SDK stub, segment-level filtering, and detection of Kick's own "black slate" transition overlay
• VOD ad-free lookup is faster and safer (time budget, thumbnail-based fast path)
• Settings reorganized into collapsible categories, with search
• "What's New" banner and this history view
• Backup & Restore: export/import all your settings as a file (with a one-time undo safety net and a "Reset to Defaults" option)
• Fixed ad-hiding not actually working visually (the CSS rule never reached the page) and only running when our own ad detection had fired — now works independently and catches more ad control overlays
• Chat: replying to your message now notifies you like an @mention does
• Chat notification popup and sound can now be toggled independently (with an optional "only when not watching" sound mode) — that smart mode now also detects when Kick's own chat panel is hidden (theater/fullscreen), not just tab-hidden or scrolled
• Fixed chat notifications silently not firing while actively watching live chat, and the extension's sound clashing with Windows' own notification sound
• Added Slovak as a new supported language
• Reviewed every translation across all 14 languages for accuracy and natural phrasing — fixed several mistranslations and formal/informal tone inconsistencies

releaseHistoryV2Body.message:
• Channel Preview Images in the Following list
• Ad Blocking (experimental) for live streams and VODs
• Bot Detection scoring for viewer counts
